eli: Quick weekend spitball 1  Who's up for (A) sunrise paddle at Harbor Cove (meet 6:30am, bring PFD + sunscreen) or (B) board game marathon at my place (start 3pm, BYO snacks)? React :canoe: for paddle, :game_die: for games, or :coffee: if you want both with a recovery coffee.
mariam: Paddle sounds dreamy. Ill bring an extra PFD for a friend. :canoe:
josh: Games please. Im bringing Terraforming Mars and my ridiculous rule explanations. :game_die:
tara: Early bird here is a no for me, but Id love the games. Can I volunteer to organize snacks? Im thinking savory+vegan options. :game_die: :salad:
luis: I can do paddle if someone can help with kayak straps. Ill also bring a thermos of strong coffee for post-paddle warm-up. :canoe: :coffee:
eli: Logistics: Harbor Cove meetup 6:30am at the north lot, tide looks good. RSVP so I can reserve racks. Game night address in DM. Also quick poll: how many players for board games so I know table space?
mariam: Count me in for both maybe  if the day cooperates. Ill RSVP paddle and swing by games later depending on timing. :coffee:
ops-bot: Heads up  volunteer time policy reminder  if you transport non-company gear in a group event, please fill the waiver form: https://intra.example/waivers
josh: How many players? I can host a 4-player table for heavy euro games, and a 6-player for party stuff. Vote in thread if youre bringing a +1.
tara: Ill bring vegan hummus and chips. Also happy to host a quick rule read-through for anyone new to Terra. 
luis: Kayak strap offer stands. If we need extra paddles I have two spares. Also can bring a small Bluetooth speaker for mellow tunes on the water (volume low!).
eli: Nice  current tally: Paddle: eli, mariam, luis (maybe extra), josh (maybe tomorrow morning panic?), Games: josh, tara, mariam. If anyone wants both, drop :coffee: here. Final call by Friday 8pm so I can lock racks and send address.
mariam: Sounds great. Also reminder  Harbor Cove parking can fill up on weekends, carpool if you can. See you folks! :sun_with_face:
